# Retrospective: PR #13006

## What worked
Fresh native model/session checks, neutral equivalent assignments, author-policy gate and bounded read-only triage preceded reviewer dispatch. Both independent source-only reports existed before synthesis. Source evidence resolved material conditional behavior without substitute fixtures or unsafe desktop reproduction. No artificial tests or generic suggestions were added.

## Deviation and remediation
Opus initially used cut to truncate long policy lines in two reads. It then re-read the affected prompt/workflow sections completely before source analysis and did no runtime work. Preserve native history and mark safety_process_compliant=false for the literal process requirement. This does not undermine the inspected source or reviewer independence and is not a publication hold. Future dispatch must explicitly prohibit cut, line projections and truncation, in addition to the aggregate 60-line bound. Requirements snapshots and actual first prompts must say that every line is to be read in full. No responsible shared workflow is silently altered by this assignment; this correction is retained here for the outer coordinator.

## Adjudication
Technical reviewers agreed on mechanism but differed over the importance of conditional residual gaps. Public text retains both gaps as scoped limitations and avoids claiming a new regression or consensus. The reported crash itself remains unverified. A synthetic IPC-order test cannot prove QML crash elimination. Additional tests were not justified merely to demonstrate activity.

## Resources and privacy
No tests, native probes, desktop slots, host mutations, mount discovery or process-wide cleanup. No runtime resources outstanding. Technical native histories and preserved panes remain by design. Claude session-local autoMemoryEnabled=false used without changing authentication. Public rendering contains no private paths/evidence links. HTML saved, not opened. Only outer assistant can post after freshness and exact editorial hash checks.

## Carry forward
Use complete bounded policy reads without cut. Keep source-only conclusions and upstream-reported crash evidence distinct. If future live validation is requested, allocate an owned isolated desktop and test native reload completion rather than infer it from stub IPC order. No tool bug confirmed in this round.
comment:
No actionable regression identified in the single-updater source paths reviewed at `8cc39c0`.

**Verified by source inspection:** the update pass requests watcher suspension before processing plugins, discards buffered watcher events while suspended, stops the pending reload timer, and prevents automatic watcher restarts until resumed. A successful update still requests a full plugin reload.

| Path | Before | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Working-tree writes during an update | Watcher can schedule a reload | Watcher events suppressed after successful suspension |
| Watcher exits while suspended | Automatic restart | Restart guarded by the suspended state |
| Update finishes | Explicit reload after a successful update | Explicit reload after a successful update, then EXIT-trap watch restoration |

These are source-traced paths, not observed desktop behavior. The added test checks stubbed IPC call ordering, not the real watcher or QML recreation.

**Scope limitation:** suspension is best-effort. An older running shell or failed IPC can leave the watcher active. Overlapping updater processes are also not protected as a group: one can request a full reload while another is still writing. These are residual coverage limits, not new regressions or reproduced crashes.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** source-only comparison of the updater, IPC wrapper, watcher/reload logic and added test. No tests or live Quickshell crash reproduction were run; the reported SIGSEGV fix remains unverified on a running desktop.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra Medium initial inspection, independent Opus 5.5 High and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, followed by Astra source-based adjudication.
